title: the sail proof's tickets raise into its scratch world
intention: The sail proof's scratch world also holds the trouble trail its tickets raise into, so running it bare or under a hollow reading writes no fixture trouble into the live lane.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: ticket-unqueued-fixture91a2a-at-clearance stood at 2x in the live lane after 91a27edfdd81's hollow reading (isolation none) of cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_sail_queues_the_ticket_at_codemothers_gates.py.
traces_to: RULE 1 (a proof measures only its component); Law 9 (a fixture's red in the live lane reads as a real one).
how: The proof's _world sets Ticket._diagnostic_roots on the class to the scratch tree's roots for its life and removes it after; a new tooth drives a cross refused at clearance and asserts where the raise landed.

clauses.claim: a sail cross refused at clearance raises ticket-unqueued-fixture91a2a-at-clearance into the scratch world's ticket trail and adds no record naming fixture91a2a to the live ~/.cairn ticket trail

decisions.text: D1: _world sets Ticket._diagnostic_roots = {repo, commons, instance} under tmp and deletes it in finally; a new tooth test_a_refused_cross_raises_into_the_scratch_world_only counts live-trail records naming fixture91a2a before and after a cross refused at clearance, and requires one scratch raise; PROVES gains this ticket's key 1. (Measured at charting: the live raise came from test_cross_with_no_target_queues_at_clearance's refusal half, not the chart tooth.)
